required_preconditions: Clean64 baseline contains zero unresolved infrastructure-invalid cells
Clean64 candidate contains zero unresolved infrastructure-invalid cells
candidate materialized harness hash is frozen before Sealed21 starts
Sealed21 manifest and task hashes pass verification

sealed_split.selection: all text-only tasks in terminal-bench-2-reliable-v2 not used by Clean64

primary_endpoint.name: paired Sealed21 pass-rate difference
primary_endpoint.metric: verifier pass fraction over two attempts per task
primary_endpoint.hypothesis_test: two-sided task-level paired sign permutation test
primary_endpoint.success_rule: delta > 0, 95% CI lower bound > 0, and p < 0.05

bootstrap.percentile_method: linear interpolation on sorted samples, q*(n-1) (Hyndman-Fan type 7)

permutation.aggregation: mean signed pass difference across attempts within task
permutation.algorithm: dynamic programming over rational task effects

analysis_integrity.permutation_implementation: two-sided exact task-level sign permutation via dynamic programming over rational task effects
analysis_integrity.run_identity: each result is bound to the frozen split, preregistration, exact evaluation TOML, role, and harness-surface SHA256
analysis_integrity.execution_code: runner, Harbor wrapper, and backend bridge source hashes are part of run_identity; analysis and validity source hashes are frozen separately
analysis_integrity.environment_snapshot: record and validate a timezone-bearing UTC timestamp, OS/architecture, Python, Harbor, Docker client/server, Git HEAD/dirty state, model alias, and HTTP(S) endpoint; missing or blank fields are rejected before confirmatory statistics
analysis_integrity.dependency_lock: bind sorted pip-freeze inventories and executable hashes for both project and Harbor Python runtimes to run_identity
analysis_integrity.container_limitation: task Dockerfiles are frozen, but their version tags are not immutable registry digests; record this as a reproducibility limitation
analysis_integrity.post_run_container_resolution: after both harness runs, inspect local base-image tags without pulling and record image ID/RepoDigest plus a stable resolution bundle; the analyzer re-parses frozen Dockerfiles and requires the snapshot reference set to match exactly, then verifies unique references, reference/resolved counts, case IDs, and completeness consistency; completeness is reported separately and does not alter the preregistered statistical success rule
analysis_integrity.cross_runtime_json_encoding: the PowerShell launcher writes execution-plan and freeze JSON as UTF-8 without a BOM; the Python analyzer accepts both standard UTF-8 and legacy UTF-8-with-BOM artifacts
analysis_integrity.checkpoint_reuse: reject reuse when the output identity marker is absent or mismatched
analysis_integrity.analysis_precondition: verify every sealed task content hash plus the frozen split, exact evaluation TOML, execution/analysis source bundles, preregistration, strict acceptance, harness surfaces, model, and baseline/candidate run identities
analysis_integrity.sealed_manifest_structure: require self_harness.sealed_split.v1, exactly 21 unique task IDs, task_count=21, outcome-blind classification, and prior_result_references=0 before confirmatory analysis
analysis_integrity.sealed_result_schema: the sealed result must contain unique JSON object keys, exactly repeat records 1 and 2, each repeat passed/total aggregate must equal the values recomputed from its case_results, every case repeat must match its outer record, and all 84 cells must have a JSON boolean passed field plus a non-null finite numeric verifier reward; malformed truthy/falsy values, missing rewards, NaN, and Infinity are rejected before invalid classification and statistics
analysis_integrity.analysis_output_metadata: sealed_analysis.v6 hashes baseline/candidate raw result.json plus the manifest, freeze, and container-resolution snapshot before and after validation and rejects any change during analysis; sealed_statistics.json records those input hashes, task/repeat/role cell counts, bootstrap seed and sample count, the linear q*(n-1) (Hyndman-Fan type 7) percentile method, exact permutation method, invalid counts, and container-resolution status; SEALED_REPORT.md repeats the design, completeness summary, and input hashes
analysis_integrity.api_key_readiness: SELF_HARNESS_QWEN_API_KEY must be non-blank in the Windows User environment; whitespace-only values do not satisfy dry-run or paid execution readiness

external_validity.target: the frozen local text-only Sealed21 task set
external_validity.claim_boundary: success supports generalization to this outcome-blind disjoint set, not to the full Terminal-Bench category distribution or media-input tasks

secondary_endpoints: Clean64 Train and Heldout five-repeat precision extension if compute budget permits

missingness_policy.classification: infrastructure-invalid is neither pass nor behavioral fail
missingness_policy.completion_rule: both harnesses must have zero unresolved invalid cells
missingness_policy.failure_rule: if invalid cells remain after allowed reruns, report Sealed21 as incomplete

anti_leakage_rules: Do not expose Sealed21 task IDs, traces, verifier outputs, scores, or failures to diagnosis or proposal stages
Do not modify the harness after any Sealed21 model call
Do not inspect or report one harness result before both baseline and candidate runs finish
Do not select replacement tasks based on outcome
Do not change the primary endpoint or success rule after sealed execution begins

multiplicity.rationale: one pre-registered model, split, contrast, and primary endpoint

interpretation.success: evidence that the frozen Qwen harness generalizes beyond proposal and promotion tasks
interpretation.failure: no confirmed sealed generalization; retain descriptive Clean64 result without generalization claim
interpretation.deepseek: exploratory only until its incomplete candidate evaluations are rerun
